instructions: What is the furthest stage of the loan sales flow the call reached? A stage counts as reached only if the agent actually started it.

criteria.s1_rpc: Only greeting and identity verification; right party may not even have been confirmed
criteria.s3_structuring: Loan amount, tenure and EMI were discussed
criteria.s4_lead_details: Employment, income, pin code or ID details were collected
criteria.s5_bureau_consent: Credit bureau consent was read out and answered
criteria.s6_scheduling: Document pickup, visit or digital completion step was being scheduled
criteria.no_connect: Call never connected to a person (voicemail, silence, wrong number)

instructions: If the customer did not complete the flow, why did the call end early? If the flow was completed, choose completed.

criteria.completed: Flow completed through scheduling or a firm next step
criteria.wrong_party_or_unavailable: Not the right person, or the customer was busy or unavailable
criteria.rate_or_fees: Rate or fees were the blocker
criteria.emi_or_affordability: EMI or affordability was the blocker
criteria.privacy_or_trust: Refused to share details or doubted the caller
criteria.documents_or_effort: Documents or process seemed like too much effort
criteria.ineligible: Customer did not meet eligibility criteria

instructions: The agent greeted the customer and introduced themselves and the company.
The agent confirmed they were speaking to the intended customer by name before sharing any financial or personal details.

criteria.true: Asked and received confirmation such as 'Am I speaking with <name>?' before the pitch
criteria.false: Moved on without confirming, or the person denied being the customer

instructions: The person on the call confirmed they are the targeted customer (right-party contact).
The agent disclosed loan or personal financial details before the customer's identity was confirmed.
The agent presented the loan offer to the customer.
The agent mentioned the customer's pre-approved status or offer eligibility.
The agent stated the maximum eligible loan amount.
The agent stated the starting interest rate.
The agent asked whether the customer is interested or wants to continue.
The customer agreed to continue the conversation after the pitch.
How did the customer react to the initial pitch?

criteria.busy: Said they were busy or asked to call later

instructions: The agent captured the loan amount the customer wants.
The agent discussed or captured the customer's preferred repayment tenure.
The agent calculated and quoted a monthly EMI to the customer.
The agent checked whether the EMI is comfortable for the customer, or addressed affordability concerns.
The customer accepted the proposed amount, tenure and EMI.
What tenure did the customer prefer or agree to?
The customer objected to the EMI amount, rate or tenure.
The agent captured whether the customer is salaried or self-employed.
What employment type did the customer state?
The agent captured the customer's employer or business name.
The agent captured the customer's net monthly income.
The agent captured the customer's pin code.
The agent captured identification details such as PAN digits.
The customer hesitated or refused to share personal or income details.
The agent read the full PAN or other sensitive identifiers aloud instead of confirming only partial digits.
The agent read the formal credit bureau consent disclosure.
The customer gave a clear, explicit verbal agreement to the credit bureau check.
Consent was obtained before the agent said the credit check was being run or started.
The agent pushed, rushed or coerced the customer into giving bureau consent.
What was the outcome of the credit bureau consent step?

criteria.ambiguous: Customer's answer was unclear or conditional

instructions: The agent tried to schedule a document pickup, executive visit or digital completion step.
A specific date and time slot was confirmed with the customer.
The agent confirmed the customer's address or location for pickup or visit.
The agent said a confirmation or application link would be sent by SMS or WhatsApp.
Which fulfilment path was agreed?

criteria.executive_visit: An executive will visit in person
criteria.digital_completion: Customer will complete digitally via link or app

instructions: How well did the agent follow the expected stage order: right-party contact, pitch, structuring, lead details, bureau consent, scheduling?
levels: Flow not followed; stages skipped or out of order
Most stages followed with minor gaps
All applicable stages followed in order
